status: minimal bore-only digital prototype; external hardware seating and headphone fit pending
planned_hardware_per_pair: Trial 2 M3 x 18 socket-head screws + 2 plain M3 nuts + 4 flat M3 washers, with head/nut outside original recesses. Actual washer dimensions, seating and final bolt length unverified. Kit labels show these parts available.
fit_preservation: Only subtract a 3.4 mm cylinder on the original bolt axis. No added material, body scaling, collar modification, head/nut pocket change, or external shape change.
limitations: Original recess does not accept a recessed standard M3 socket head or M3 nut.
Flat washers must span original recesses. Curved seating may rock or contact unevenly; must be hand-tested before accepting kit design.
Do not force M3 bolts into original M2 prints.
Digital slicing is not a load, endurance, hardware or headphone fit test.
